channel.title: BC Arts Grants Weekly Updates
channel.description: New and approaching funding opportunities for artists, arts organizations, and eligible community arts projects in British Columbia.

item.title: Community Climate Action Grant — City of Vancouver
item.description: Deadline: October 1, 2026. Up to $50,000 for community-led climate action; aligned creative public engagement and arts-based approaches may be eligible.

item.title: 2027 Cultural Grants — City of Surrey
item.description: Deadline: October 5, 2026. Open support for Surrey arts, culture and heritage through celebration, project and operating categories.

item.title: 2027 Culture Project Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Deadline: October 6, 2026. Supports culture and heritage projects contributing to Nanaimo’s cultural, social and economic vitality.

item.title: 2027 Culture Operating Grant — City of Nanaimo
item.description: Deadline: October 6, 2026. Annual operating support for qualifying professional arts, culture and heritage non-profits in Nanaimo.

item.title: Individual Arts Grants: Creative Writers — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 7, 2026. Project support for professional B.C. writers undertaking specific creative writing projects.

item.title: Circulation and Touring — Canada Council for the Arts
item.description: Deadline: October 7, 2026. Supports circulation and touring of Canadian artists, exhibitions and artistic works.

item.title: Accelerate Program — BC Arts Council
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. A two-year initiative to improve access and reduce funding barriers for equity-deserving and regional arts groups.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Community Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for organizations providing public access to arts and culture and developing community leadership.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Museums & Indigenous Cultural Centres
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Supports annual public, curatorial and collections programs of eligible museums and Indigenous cultural centres.

item.title: Operating Assistance: Visual & Media Arts Organizations
item.description: Deadline: October 8, 2026. Operating support for sustained public, artistic and curatorial programs in visual and media arts.
